scammer_turns.text: Good afternoon. Am I speaking to the homeowner? This is Officer Daniel Hughes from the enforcement division at HM Revenue and Customs.
I'm calling because there is a warrant out for your arrest over unpaid tax from the last four years. This is your final notice.
Our records show you owe 2850 pounds, including penalties. If it isn't settled today, the local police will be sent to your address this evening.
I must tell you this call is being recorded, and if you put the phone down the case goes straight to the magistrates court.
Your case number is TX-40387-B. Please write that down, you'll need it to stop the warrant.
Now, the quickest way to clear this today is with gift cards. You can buy them at any supermarket or corner shop.
Buy the cards in amounts of 250 pounds until you reach the total, then scratch off the back and read me the codes.
Do not tell the shop assistant what the cards are for. If they ask, say they're a present for your grandson, because this is a confidential legal matter.
If the line drops, call me straight back on 07700 900233 and quote your case number. Do not call the main helpline, they don't deal with warrants.
Before we go any further, I need to confirm your identity. What is your full date of birth?
